en: Vintage black-and-white postcard with decorative scrollwork, showing two different exterior views of a large institutional building complex. The upper right image depicts a long, two‑story frame building with porches and staircases; the lower left image shows another large multi‑story structure with a central tower topped by a cross, suggesting a religiously affiliated hospital. Printed caption text appears in the lower right, with handwritten numbers in ink over part of the design.
